title: VTuber Model Commission Request - $3000 Budget
content:
💙🧡 VTUBER MODEL COMMISSION REQUEST — $3,000 BUDGET! 🧡💙

🎨 I'm looking for a talented artist to help bring my HeartAlicious debut VTuber model to life!

💰 Budget: $3,000
📅 Timeline: Looking to commission within 5–7 months.
✨ Looking for: Full model design, professional rigging, expressions, toggles, and the complete VTuber package!
❤️ Important: I openly use AI-assisted artwork as part of my content. I'm looking for an artist who respects that creative choice, regardless of differing opinions. I want a positive, drama-free working relationship built on mutual respect.
🎨 I'm also completely open to artistic freedom! You're welcome to redesign, improve, remove, or add elements to my current AI-assisted concept to make something truly unique.

💙 Serious artists only, please DM! I'll be reposting this once a month until I find the right artist who connects with my character, content, and creative vision.

Thank you! I look forward to supporting an artist and bringing HeartAlicious to life! 🧡💙

#VTuber #VTuberCommission #Live2D #VTuberArtist #HeartAlicious
